processing: Source crops used only as generation references. Remove alpha <=8 (<=2 for glow/translucent categories: clouds,collectibles,portals,star-trees,mushrooms,crystals,foregrounds,props,rocks,cliffs) and components below8 pixels. For solid modules remove low-alpha residue farther than12 pixels from alpha>=128. No hole filling or recoloring. Trim alpha bounds, fit860px, center on1024px canvas. Plates preserve aspect ratio at max1536px. Lanczos exports. Lossless WebP.
